    3. Read quality control

    Figure 1

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of mean Phred score against read position for six files; all lines lie close together near 35 to 36 in the green zone and dip slightly over the last cycles’

    Figure 2

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Three cartoon quality plots: read 2 quality collapsing while read 1 stays high, a short quality bump followed by a drop, and a stable high profile’

    Figure 3

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of read counts against mean read quality for six files; the curves are flat near zero below 30 and rise to a single sharp peak of 5 to 6 million reads at quality 36’

    Figure 4

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Three cartoon histograms of per read quality: a single peak at low quality, two peaks, and one sharp peak at high quality’

    Figure 5

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of the percentage of reads against GC content for six files; the curves overlap almost perfectly, rising to a peak of about 4% of reads at 40% GC, with a shoulder around 45 to 50% GC, and falling to near zero by 70% GC’

    Figure 6

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Three cartoon GC content plots: two shifted peaks, one skewed peak, and an observed peak matching the expected curve’

    Figure 7

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Three cartoon N content plots: a curve rising at the end of the read, a flat line above zero, and a flat line at zero’

    Figure 8

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of the percentage of the library against duplication level for six files; all curves start at about 73 to 75% at level 1, drop to about 17 to 18% at level 2 and 3% at level 3, and stay near zero after that’

    Figure 9

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Three cartoon duplication plots: a slowly decaying curve, a wavy pattern, and a single spike at duplication level one’

    Figure 10

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of the percentage of reads containing adapter sequence against read position; one group of lines rises steadily to about 1.5% at position 140, a second group stays near zero and rises to about 0.5% over the last 30 positions, all within the green pass zone’

    Figure 11

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Two cartoon adapter content plots: a curve rising toward the end of the read, and a flat line at zero’

    4. Read alignment and alignment QC

    Figure 1

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC stacked horizontal bar chart, one bar per sample (HG002, HG003, HG004); each bar is about 95% blue for reads mapped with MQ above 0, about 5% orange for MQ0 reads, and a barely visible red sliver for unmapped reads’

    Figure 2

    Image 1 of 1: ‘MultiQC line plot of the percentage of chromosome 20 covered by at least X reads against X for three samples; the three curves overlap, stay near 98 to 99% up to about 20x, fall steeply between 30x and 45x, and drop to a few percent by about 55x’

    5A. Calling variants with bcftools

    6. Filtering and evaluating variant calls

    Figure 1

    Image 1 of 1: ‘Line plot of precision (y axis, 0.868 to 1.0) against recall (x axis, 0 to 1). A solid blue SNV curve runs almost flat near precision 0.995 to 1.0 from recall 0 to about 0.97, then drops steeply to 0.979 at recall 0.988; a blue circle marks the SNV PASS point at recall 0.981, precision 0.989. A dashed red indel curve starts near precision 0.998 at recall 0.06, falls to about 0.935 by recall 0.16, wanders between 0.90 and 0.92 up to recall 0.75, and drops to 0.872 at recall 0.84; a red square marks the indel PASS point at recall 0.779, precision 0.930, above the dashed curve.’
